analyzed: utpanna rūpām devatām pratipādya mantram pratipādayan āha japam ityādi āli kālyoḥ prajñā upāya rūpayoḥ parama mantra tvāt tat dhyeyam ityādi

original: nanv evam aparimitacittaprasarānirodhe vikṣepa eva na dhyānam iti dhyeyam api tan na syād ity āha | pitarītyādi | tatsukhaṃ bhuñjyate svayam iti yathopadeśam abhyāsād ajasram | yauvanābhiṣekayor vā evam ādimadhyāvasāneṣu | yat sukhaṃ tad anuparamam anubhūyamānaṃ dhyānam ucyate |
analyzed: nanu evam aparimita citta prasara anirodhe vikṣepaḥ eva na dhyānam iti dhyeyam api tat na syāt iti āha pitari ityādi tat sukham bhuñjyate svayam iti yathopadeśam abhyāsāt ajasram yauvana abhiṣekayoḥ vā evam ādi madhya avasāneṣu yat sukham tat anuparamam anubhūyamānam dhyānam ucyate

original: evam aparāparāpareṣv api cintiteṣv anuparatapravāhiṇā mahāsukhasyānusmaraṇāt | (62v/126) kuto vikṣepaḥ yato na dhyānadhyeye syātām ity abhiprāyaḥ | atha vā pitarīti gurāv abhiṣekakāle yat prāptam anubhūtaṃ sahajamahāsukhaṃ tad bhujyate ābhujyate svayam anyadāpi | mudrāyogato vā tathaivopabhujyate |
analyzed: evam apara apara apareṣu api cintiteṣu anuparata pravāhiṇā mahā sukhasya anusmaraṇāt kutas vikṣepaḥ yatas na dhyāna dhyeye syātām iti abhiprāyaḥ atha vā pitari iti gurau abhiṣeka kāle yat prāptam anubhūtam sahaja mahā sukham tat bhujyate ābhujyate svayam anyadā api mudrā yogataḥ vā tathā eva upabhujyate
